title: gRNA Design and Cloning with SapI into Loop Plasmid L2_lacZgRNA-Cas9-CsA
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.93wh8pe
materials: Oligo annealing Mix oligos with water as follow: oligo F (100μM) 1μl oligo R (100μM) 1μl water 8μl Total volume 10μl Anneal in a thermocycler using the following parameters: 37 o C for 30 min, 95 o C for 5 min and then ramp down to 25 o C at 5 o C per min. After annealing the gRNA can be directly cloned into L2_lacZgRNACas9-CsA plasmid without the need of any further processing (step 4).

Cloning into backbone vector In a 0.2 mL tube set up the following reaction: Place samples on the thermocycler and incubated using the following program: Assembly: 15 cycles: 3 minutes at 37 o C and 4 minutes at 16 o C Termination: 5 minutes at 50 o C and 10 minutes at 80 o C Transform chemically competent using 1 μL of reaction and plate on LB agar plates with 100 μg/mL spec and X-gal 40. Incubate at 37 oC for 16 h. Confirm with sequencing

steps.title: Design SapI-compatible gRNA oligos
steps.instruction: Create two oligonucleotides that contain the 20‑nt guide sequence and the SapI overhangs required for ligation into the L2_lacZgRNA‑Cas9‑CsA vector.

substeps.instruction: Forward oligo (oligo F): 5'-TCG‑<NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN>-gt-3' (TCG overhang at the 5' end, guide sequence in the middle, and a trailing 'gt' to complete the gRNA scaffold).
Reverse oligo (oligo R): 5'-AAAac‑<NNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNNN>-3' (AAAac overhang at the 5' end; this overhang together with the forward strand’s 'gt' reconstitutes the full scaffold).
Confirm that the SapI‑digested L2_lacZgRNA‑Cas9‑CsA vector presents AGC and TTT overhangs, which are compatible with the TCG and gt‑AAA overhangs of the designed oligos.

steps.title: Order the designed oligos
steps.instruction: Place an order for the two designed oligos using standard desalted synthesis (no special purification required).
